name: qjs_application_vtable

ownership.argument: Application RAM dispatcher table (two Itanium prefix words then the primary slots). Slot 2 is the JS-task initialize entry that the module wraps to register its Feature before the QuickApp starts.

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.139 image/IDB, compared with xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155: the whole 52-word table at 0x2ca7c2e4 equals the .155 table at 0x2ca7c2d4 with every entry shifted by the same +0x10, and two matched functions reference it from the same instruction position.

notes: Address catalogue only; the table layout is proven equal to the .155 audit.
